games.guess-number.name: Ballpark
games.guess-number.description: Guess the number. Who will get closest?
games.guess-number.goal: Guess the number from the question and score points — the closer you get to the real answer, the more you earn.
games.guess-number.steps.1: One person reads the question aloud. The answer is a number: a count, a year or a measurement.
games.guess-number.steps.2: The phone goes around the players in order. Each player enters a number and taps “Submit”.
games.guess-number.steps.3: When everyone has guessed, tap “Reveal answer” to see the correct answer and a ranking from the closest guess.
games.guess-number.steps.4: The ranking shows each guess, its distance from the answer and the points earned. The closest player starts the next question, then the others in ranking order.
games.guess-number.steps.5: The closer you are, the more points you get: first place earns as many points as there are players, each next place one fewer. An exact hit gives a bonus.
games.guess-number.steps.6: A game has {count} questions. The highest total wins; if the totals are equal, there are several winners.
games.guess-number.tips.1: Earlier guesses stay visible in the list, so order matters.
games.guess-number.tips.2: You can guess the same number as the player before you — that is allowed.
games.guess-number.tips.3: You can open the score table with the “Results” button during the game — it does not change the guessing order.
games.guess-number.questionHint: Read the question aloud — everyone else guesses a number.
games.guess-number.allGuessedHint: Check the guesses, then reveal the correct answer.
games.guess-number.turnHint: Pass the phone to the current player — earlier guesses are shown below.
games.guess-number.nextOrderHint: In the next question, players guess in this ranking order.
games.guess-number.standingsHint: Total points from the questions played so far.

games.revolver.name: Half a Word
games.revolver.description: Two teams, one secret word and one word at a time.
games.revolver.goal: Be the first team to guess the secret word.
games.revolver.steps.1: Split into two teams — randomly or by tapping names. Each team needs at least 2 players.
games.revolver.steps.2: Each round, one player from each team takes the phone and taps “Show the word”. Everyone else looks away.
games.revolver.steps.3: Both players see the same word and take turns saying one word each. The team shown on screen says the first word.
games.revolver.steps.4: When a team guesses it, tap “Team 1 guessed it” or “Team 2 guessed it”. If nobody guesses or someone cheats, use “Cancel round (0 pts)”.
games.revolver.steps.5: The game lasts as many rounds as there are players on the larger team. One point per round won; the team with more points wins.
games.revolver.tips.1: Agree on the details before the game, for example whether you may use words from the secret word.
games.revolver.tips.2: The “Pass the phone on” screen makes sure nobody sees the word too early.
games.revolver.alternateHint: Take turns saying one word at a time until one team guesses it.
games.revolver.exitFooter: End the game and return to the hub
games.revolver.exitMessage: You will return to the hub and the current game will be lost — results are not saved.

games.duel.name: Ping-Pong
games.duel.description: One category, two rivals and a chess clock.
games.duel.goal: Name things from the category faster than your rival and don't get caught out by the clock.
games.duel.steps.1: Split into two teams. Each round, one player from each team duels.
games.duel.steps.2: Place the phone between you and tap “Start”. Each player has their own half of the screen and one time pool: {seconds} s for the whole duel.
games.duel.steps.3: The clock runs for the player shown as the starter. They name one thing from the category and tap their half of the screen.
games.duel.steps.4: When they tap, their clock stops at the remaining time and the opponent's clock starts. Whoever fails to name something loses.
games.duel.steps.5: The other team scores a point. There are as many rounds as there are players on the larger team.
games.duel.tips.1: You may not repeat things that have already been said.
games.duel.tips.2: If there is a dispute, use “Pause” and then “Resume” — the clock stops.
games.duel.exitFooter: End the game and return to the hub
games.duel.exitMessage: You will return to the hub and the current game will be lost — results are not saved.
games.duel.abortMessage: This duel will not be finished. You will return to the hub.

games.sect.name: Vampire
games.sect.description: Vampires are hiding in a small town. The game master runs the night and the day.
games.sect.goal: The townsfolk must uncover the vampires, and the vampires must take over the town.
games.sect.steps.1: One person becomes the game master: they do not play, they only hold the phone and run the game.
games.sect.steps.2: Everyone taps their own name on the list and checks their role. After hiding the role, the name is locked.
games.sect.steps.3: At night everyone closes their eyes, and the game master wakes the vampires, the healer and the hunter according to the script.
games.sect.steps.4: In the morning the game master announces the result of the night.
games.sect.steps.5: During the day everyone discusses and together points to the person who is out.
games.sect.steps.6: The game continues until the vampires or the townsfolk win.
games.sect.tips.1: The game master reads aloud only the texts in the “Say aloud” block. At night, hold the phone so nobody can see the screen.
games.sect.tips.2: Larger groups get extra roles: the apprentice (knows the healer and takes over their power if the healer dies) and the commander (once per game, during the day, decides who is out and reveals themselves).
games.sect.roles.villager.name: Townsfolk
games.sect.roles.villager.reveal: You have no special power. During the day you discuss and vote with the town.
games.sect.roles.sect.name: Vampire
games.sect.roles.sect.reveal: If there are more vampires, you will meet on the first night, when the game master asks the vampires to open their eyes. Each night the vampires point to one person to attack.
games.sect.roles.doctor.name: Healer
games.sect.roles.doctor.reveal: At night you protect one person from the vampires' attack, not the same person two nights in a row.
games.sect.roles.detective.name: Hunter
games.sect.roles.detective.reveal: Each night you can check one person: are they a vampire?
games.sect.roles.apprentice.name: Apprentice
games.sect.roles.apprentice.reveal: You know the healer. If the healer dies, you take over their power from the next night.
games.sect.roles.commander.name: Commander
games.sect.roles.commander.reveal: Once per game, during the day, you can take over the vote and decide yourself who is out. You must reveal yourself when you do.

games.sect.script.nightStart.say: Night falls. Everyone, close your eyes and lower your heads.
games.sect.script.nightStart.do: Wait until everyone has closed their eyes and lowered their heads.
games.sect.script.sect.sayFirst: The vampires open their eyes. Look at one another so you know each other. Now silently point to one person you want to attack.
games.sect.script.sect.sayAgain: The vampires open their eyes. Silently point to one person you want to attack.
games.sect.script.sect.do: Watch who they point at. Tap the chosen person's name (it may be a vampire) and confirm. If they disagree, choose the person most of them pointed at.
games.sect.script.sectClose.do: Wait a moment until the vampires close their eyes.
games.sect.script.healerMeet.say: The healer and the apprentice open their eyes. Look at each other so you know each other.
games.sect.script.healerMeet.do: Wait a moment until they have seen each other. Do not choose anyone.
games.sect.script.apprenticeClose.do: Wait a moment. The healer still has their eyes open.
games.sect.script.doctor.say: The healer opens their eyes. Point to the person you want to protect tonight.
games.sect.script.doctor.sayAfterMeet: Healer, point to the person you want to protect tonight.
games.sect.script.doctor.doAlive: Tap the chosen person and confirm. The person protected last night is blocked.
games.sect.script.doctor.doApprentice: The apprentice now holds the healer's power: {name}. Tap the person the apprentice points to and confirm. The person protected last night is blocked.
games.sect.script.doctor.doDead: The healer is dead. Say the same words and wait about 5–8 seconds so nobody knows the role is gone. Do not choose anyone.
games.sect.script.detective.say: The hunter opens their eyes. Point to the person you want to check.
games.sect.script.detective.doAlive: Tap the chosen person (alive, not the hunter) and confirm.
games.sect.script.detective.doDead: The hunter is dead. Say the same words and wait about 5–8 seconds so nobody knows the role is gone. Do not choose anyone.
games.sect.script.nightEnd.say: Morning comes. Everyone opens their eyes.
games.sect.script.morning.savedDetail: The healer's protection saved the vampires' victim.
games.sect.script.morning.noTargetDetail: The vampires did not choose anyone.
games.sect.script.day.discussionSay: Begin the discussion. Afterwards you will decide together who is out of the game.
games.sect.script.day.discussionDo: Start the timer if you want to limit the discussion, then move on to the vote.
games.sect.script.day.voteSay: Who is out? Point to one person together or choose “Nobody is out”.
games.sect.script.day.voteDo: Tap the name of the person who is out (or “Nobody is out”) and confirm.
games.sect.script.day.resultDo: Check the win condition and continue.
games.sect.script.commander.say: Commander {name} reveals themselves and takes over the vote.
games.sect.script.commander.do: Tap the person the commander points to (alive, not the commander) and confirm. “Undo step” returns to the normal vote.
games.sect.script.dayResult.removed: The person out of the game: {name}. Their role: {role}.
games.sect.script.finish.villagers: The townsfolk win: the vampires have been uncovered.
games.sect.script.finish.sect: The vampires win: the town belongs to them.
games.sect.script.detectiveResult.notSec: This person IS NOT a vampire
games.sect.script.detectiveResult.gestur: Show the hunter a thumbs up if they are a vampire, or a thumbs down if they are not.
games.sect.log.apprenticeHealer: the apprentice holds the healer's power: {name}
games.sect.log.saved: nobody died, the victim was saved
games.sect.log.dayCommander: Day {day}: the commander ({name}) took over the vote; out of the game: {target}.
games.sect.finished.title: Game over
games.sect.finished.subtitle: Roles are revealed. Read the result aloud.
games.sect.finished.hint: “New roles” starts another game with the same people: roles are dealt again and everyone checks theirs.

games.sect.board.title: Game master board

games.sect.guideScreen.title: Game master instructions
games.sect.guideScreen.subtitle: Read before the first night. Scroll the screen with your finger.
games.sect.ui.exitFooter: End the game and return to the hub
games.sect.guide.roles.title: Who you are
games.sect.guide.roles.point1: You are the game master. You do not play, have no role and do not vote. You run the game and you are the only one who knows all the roles.
games.sect.guide.roles.point2: Hold the phone so nobody can see the screen.
games.sect.guide.roles.point3: Secret information (roles, night choices, investigation results) appears only while you hold the button.
games.sect.guide.roles.point4: Read aloud only the “Say aloud” blocks. The “Do” block is for you alone.
games.sect.guide.before.title: Before the game
games.sect.guide.before.point1: Sit in a circle. Each player taps their own name on the list and checks their role without showing it to anyone. If the game master is on the player list, the list needs at least 6 people.
games.sect.guide.before.point2: If someone tapped the wrong name, use “Allow checking the role again” in “Role preview”.
games.sect.guide.before.point3: When everyone knows their roles, take the phone back and tap “Handed to the game master”.
games.sect.guide.night.title: Night
games.sect.guide.night.point1: Everyone closes their eyes and lowers their heads.
games.sect.guide.night.point2: Wake the vampires, the healer and the hunter one by one. The woken player opens their eyes and points to their chosen person with a gesture, without speaking.
games.sect.guide.night.point3: Tap the chosen person's name and confirm with “Confirm”. The app marks them automatically: 🩸 the vampires' victim, 🌿 protected by the healer, 🔍 checked by the hunter.
games.sect.guide.night.point4: Show the hunter the result with a gesture: thumbs up = vampire, thumbs down = not a vampire.
games.sect.guide.night.point5: If the healer or the hunter is dead, still “wake” the role with the words and wait 5–8 seconds so nobody realises it is gone.
games.sect.guide.night.point6: Made a mistake? Use “Undo step” on the night screen.
games.sect.guide.morning.title: Morning
games.sect.guide.morning.point1: The app resolves the night itself: the vampires' victim dies unless the healer protected them.
games.sect.guide.morning.point2: Read only the announcement. Do not reveal who the victim was or whom the healer protected if nobody died.
games.sect.guide.morning.point3: The deceased gets the 💀 marker, does not speak, does not vote and does not reveal their role, but may watch the game in silence.
games.sect.guide.day.title: Day
games.sect.guide.day.point1: The players discuss — you can start the timer with “Start” and “Stop”.
games.sect.guide.day.point2: Then, together (for example by raising hands), they point to the person who is out, and you tap their name and “Confirm”.
games.sect.guide.day.point3: In a tie or if there is no decision, choose “Nobody is out”.
games.sect.guide.day.point4: Read the role of the eliminated player exactly as the screen shows it.
games.sect.guide.apprentice.title: Apprentice (extra role)
games.sect.guide.apprentice.point1: On the first night, in the healer's step, wake the healer and the apprentice together so they know each other. Then the apprentice closes their eyes and the healer chooses as usual — you tap only the healer's choice.
games.sect.guide.apprentice.point2: If the healer dies (at night or during the day) and the apprentice is alive, the apprentice holds the healer's power from the next night. Wake them with the same words “The healer opens their eyes…”; the “Do” block tells you who holds the power.
games.sect.guide.apprentice.point3: The “not the same person two nights in a row” rule carries over to the apprentice. If both are dead, the healer's step is a decoy (wait 5–8 seconds).
games.sect.guide.commander.title: Commander (extra role)
games.sect.guide.commander.point1: Once per game, only during the day and only while alive, the commander may take over the vote. When they speak up, tap “Commander takes over the vote” on the vote screen and confirm.
games.sect.guide.commander.point2: Read the text on the screen aloud: the commander reveals themselves to everyone and chooses who is out (alive, not themselves). Then read the result as after a normal vote.
games.sect.guide.commander.point3: From then on the commander's role is public (⭐ on the Board) and the power does not come back. Changed their mind before confirming? “Undo step” returns to the normal vote.
games.sect.guide.end.title: Game over
games.sect.guide.end.point1: The townsfolk win when there are no vampires left.
games.sect.guide.end.point2: The vampires win when there are as many vampires as the other living players, or more.
games.sect.guide.disputes.title: Disputed situations
games.sect.guide.disputes.point1: The vampires cannot agree: choose the person most of them pointed at.
games.sect.guide.disputes.point2: The healer may protect themselves, but not the same person two nights in a row.
games.sect.guide.disputes.point3: The hunter checks only living players and never themselves.
games.sect.guide.disputes.point4: Made a mistake? Use “Undo step” or the “Correct manually” button on the “Board”.
games.sect.guide.legend.title: Marker legend
games.sect.guide.legend.point5: ⭐ commander, public after taking over the vote (public part of the Board)
games.sect.guide.legend.point6: 🎓 apprentice holding the healer's power (secret part of the Board)
